style.vernacular: Dense Spanish-colonial and eclectic stock: 2-4 storey stucco townhouses with arcaded portales, tall wooden shutters and wrought-iron balconies in sun-faded pastels (ochre, pink, turquoise, cream), many peeling or stained; Vedado and Miramar mansions with columned porches; 1950s modernist slabs and flat-roofed concrete blocks, Soviet-era prefab blocks outside the centre; flat concrete roofs with water tanks, clay tile on older houses; royal palms and laurel/ficus shade trees.
style.ornament: Arcaded portales and Doric/Ionic column rows, fanlights (mediopuntos) in stained glass over doors, wooden louvred shutters, wrought-iron balcony rails, baroque cornices and parapets, art-deco bands on 1930s-50s blocks, revolutionary murals and steel-outline portraits on state buildings.

sources.what: colourful Spanish Colonial-era buildings, classical 19th-century mansions, Old Havana and Vedado districts

eclectic Plateresque-influenced station architecture
